builder.objective: V2-01 REPAIR (cycle 2) — Fix 1 remaining mustFix regression. Preserve the existing WIP baseline (commit 09e724d, 133 tests green). Fix only the following, do not expand scope.

repairFindings.problem: In demo-premium mode, getAccountEntitlement consults AccountRepository.ownedFreeHouseholdId and returns canCreateFreeHousehold=false after the first household is created. However, createHousehold bypasses this check in demo-premium mode (always allows creation). This creates an inconsistency: the 'Create household' button on the root screen is disabled (canCreateHousehold calls getAccountEntitlement) while the use-case still permits creation. The demo must be a fully unlocked Premium test environment (MAIN_PROMPT: 'entitlement Premium de test entièrement débloqué... exploration et audits de toutes les fonctions').
repairFindings.requiredFix: In demo-premium mode, getAccountEntitlement must always return canCreateFreeHousehold=true (consistent with createHousehold's demo-premium bypass). It should still report accurate ownedFreeHouseholdId from AccountRepository for UI state. In demo-free mode, the one-free-household rule remains enforced via ownedFreeHouseholdId===null.
repairFindings.verification: Deterministic test: adapter in demo-premium, create user, create first household → getAccountEntitlement returns canCreateFreeHousehold=true, ownedFreeHouseholdId=first household id, ownedHouseholdCount=1. Second createHousehold call succeeds and getAccountEntitlement still returns canCreateFreeHousehold=true. In demo-free mode: after first household, canCreateFreeHousehold=false. npm run check vert.
